rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 30 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'DEPARTMENT OF INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990' WAIVING THE HEIGHT AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS FOR ACCEPTANCE TO THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE OF APPLICANTS FROMTHE AUTONOMOUS REGION OF MUSLIM MINDANAO AND THE CORDILLERA ADMINISTRATIVE REGION
rows.abstract: Rationale: The present situation in the ARMM and the CAR requires the integration of "rebel returnees" to the mainstream with either the ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES and/or the PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE as option against earlier request for thecreation and organization of the autonomous region's own Regional Security Force. > This would however be possible only if the laws governing both the AFP and PNP are amended to accommodate integrees who by sheer lack of opportunity would not have been able to obtain the required educational units or by culture, and heredity and/or environment could not not reach the minimum height requirements.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10089

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 3, 6 AND 8 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7919, KNOWN AS 'THE ALIEN SOCIAL INTEGRATION ACT OF 1995'
rows.abstract: Provides for the following --- "Section 3. Coverage. - Upon effectivity of this Act, all aliens whose stay in the Philippines is otherwise illegal under existing laws, and who have entered the country prior to June 30, 1992 are hereby granted legalresidence status upon compliance with the provisions of this Act, and shall not be prosecuted from crimes defined Under Commonwealth Act No. 613, otherwise known as the Immigration Act of 1940, which are inherent to illegal residence such as the absence of valid travel documents or visa: Provided, that in no case shall alien refugees in the Philippines be qualified to apply under this Act. Provided, further, that those aliens granted legal permanent residency under E.O. 324 are recognized to belegal residents and will no longer be required to re-apply for legal residency under this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08497

rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COMELEC TO DEPUTIZE QUALIFIED CADETS OF THE RESERVED OFFICERS TRAINING CORPS AND THE CITIZENS MILITARY TRAINING DURING ELECTIONS, PLEBISCITES, REFERENDA AND OTHER ELECTORAL EVENTS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Rationale: the move of deploying the cadets is in consonance with Section 13 of Article II of the Declaration of Principles that "the State recognizes the vital role of the youth in nation building ... and shall encourage their invovlement in publicand civic affairs." Authorizes the commandants of ROTC and CMT units in both public and private schools to screen volunteer cadets for this purpose. Prescribes allowances for these qualified cadets.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 1996-10-17

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE EXAMINATION AND INSPECTION OF FISH OR EDIBLE MARINE PRODUCTS THAT ARE SOLD OR DISTRIBUTED FOR CONSUMPTION TO THE PUBLIC, AND PROVIDING STIFFER PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Defines "FISH OR EDIBLE MARINE PRODUCTS" as used in this Act.  Mandates the following --- "SEC. 3. All fish or any edible marine product found to be stale, purified or decomposed, diseased, poisonous, or caught with the use of explosives or toxic substances such as cyanide, etc., and contaminated with red tide organism, or containing levels of mercury, shall be condemned or disposed of in accordance with existing rules and regualtions promulgated jointly by the Secretary of Health, the Directorof the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources any existing interagency committee concerned. Prescribes penalties for violation of this provision.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1996-10-17

rows.title_full: AN ACT FIXING THE MINIMUM AMOUNT OF INVESTIBLE FUNDS OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY SYSTEM AND THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM FOR LOW-COST HOUSING, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE SECTION 26, SUBPARAGRAPH D OF THE SOCIAL SECURITY LAW, OTHERWISE KNOWN ASREPUBLIC ACT NO. 1161, AS AMENDED, AND SECTION 30 OF THE REVISED GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE ACT, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1146
rows.abstract: Rationale: The Philippine Government adopted a national shelter program sometime ago, with, the aim of alleviating the country's grave problem on housing. It has set itself to build 1.2 million low-cost housing units by the year 1998. > The nobilityof the program however is currently being undermined in that, designated government agencies tasked with contributing funds for the housing project have not been complying with their obligations on time.  Such has prompted adverse response from participating housing developers and their affiliates, who decided to withdraw from the program. > Provides for the following --- "SEC. 30. Investment of Funds.  Funds of the sytem not needed to meet the current obligation may be invested under such termms and conditions as may be determined by the Board.[.]:PROVI DED, THAT AT LEAST THIRTY PERCENT (30%) OF THE INVESTIBLE FUNDS SHALL BE UTILIZED FOR LOW-COST HOUSING PURPOSES."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT since 1996-10-17

rows.abstract: "Philippine HIV/AIDS Prevention and Control Act of 1994" Provides for the establishment of an HIV/AIDS monitoring and feedback mechanism to report on the occurrence of the diseases in the country. Provides GUIDELINES on HIV anti-body testing and counselling, medical and other practices that carry the risk of HIV transmission; states what are considered DISCRIMINATION ACTS AND POLICIES.

rows.abstract: Rationale: The constitutional safeguard of due process is briefly worded thus: "No person shall be deprived of life, liberty and property without due process of law" (Art. II, Sec. 1, 1987 Constitution). Proposes these amendments to the Local Government Code provision on PREVENTIVE SUSPENSION: (1) Preventive suspension SHALL BE IMPOSED ONLY AFTER A PRELIMINARY HEARING HAS BEEN CONDUCTED AND UPON A RECOMMENDATION SUBMITTED BY THE APPROPRIATE COMMITTEE, AS THE CASE MAYBE, WHEN BOTH PARTIES HAVE BEEN GIVEN AS OPPORTUNITY TO PRESENT THEIR SIDES AND UPON FINDING THAT THE EVIDENCE OF GUILT IS STRONG. Provided: that any single preventive suspension of the lcoal elective official shall not extend beyond sixty (60) days. (2) SEC. 63-A. PREVENTIVE SSUSPENSION SHALL MOTU PROPRIO BE IMPOSED: (1) WHEN THE OFFENSE CHARGED IS PUNISHABLE BY PRISION MAYOR TO DEATH; (2) WHEN THE EVIDENCE OF GUILT IS STRONG; AND (3) IF THE PUBLIC OFFICIAL CONCERNED, DURING THE PENDENCY OF THE HEARING, UTILIZE HIS PUBLIC

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 343 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991,' AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR(NOTE: BENEFITS OF BARANGAY OFFICIALS)
rows.abstract: Rationale: With the effectivity of the Local Government Code of 1991, the powers and functions of the barangay officials are correspondingly expanded. Unfortunately, the affected barangay officials received minimal compensation for their services. Proposes the following --- "Sec. 393. Benefits of Barangay Officials - (a) Barangay officials including barangay tanods and members of the lupong tagapamayapa , shall received honoraria, allowances and such other emoluments as may be authorized by lawor barangay, municipal or city ordinance in accordance with the provisions of this Code, but in no case shall it be less than TWO THOUSAND PESOS (P2,000.00) per month for the punong barangay and ONE THOUSAND PESOS (P1,000.00) per month for the sanggguniang barangay members, barangay treasurerm and barangay secretary: x x x."

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE COUNCIL OF VETERANS OF WORLD WAR II IN THE PHILIPPINE VETERANS AFFAIRS OFFICE
rows.abstract: Rationale: This refers to a provision of RA 7169 which provided for the designation of the BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF THE VETERANS OF WORLD WAR II (BTVWWII) as the trustee of all issued but undelivered shares of stock of the Philippine Veterans Bank. Complaints of discrimination by the BTVWWII has been raised. Seeks to ABOLISH THE BTVWWII and in its place, create another body under the direct supervision of the PVAO. This proposed body is the COUNCIL OF VETERANS OF WORLD WAR II.

rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER AMENDING SECTION 13 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3019, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE ANTI-GRAFT AND CORRUPT PRACTICES ACT(NOTE: PROVISION ON SUSPENSION FROM OFFICE)
rows.abstract: Rationale: The purpose of the "suspension from office" under Section 13 of R.A. No. 3019, otherwise known as the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, which is prevenetive in character, is to prevent the accused official or employee from influencingor coercing witnesses who are most likely his co-officials or subordinates, or to prevent the accused official from any access to relevant documents and papers filed in the said office while the case is in trial. States that the provision on "SUSPENSION FROM OFFICE" shall NOT apply if the accused is NO LONFER occupying that office by venture of transfer, promotion or election.

rows.abstract: Rationale: The most recent gambling craze to adversely affect our youth is the mechanical game of videokarera. the proliferation of videokarera machines in the Metropolitan area has definitely brought about pernicious and debilitating effects on ourcountrymen. The game easily attracts young students and is even more appealing to the out-of-school youth. Seeks to include VIDEOKARERA as one of the prohibited games under PD 1602.

rows.abstract: "Domestic Violence Act of 1996" Defines "DOMESTIC VIOLENCE " as used in this Act; states certain acts considered as domestic violence. rows.author: B010
rows.title_full: AN ACT OFFICIALLY ACKNOWLEDGING THE HEROISM OF BISHOP GREGORIO AGLIPAY
rows.abstract: Rationale: Obispo Gregorio Aglipay is not only a minsiter of God but also a parliamentarian . He was the only priest who was a member of the Malolos Congress which drafted the first independent written Cosntitution of the Philippines. It is also noteworthy to mention that he was a contemporary and good friend of our National Hero, Jose Rizal. In constract with Rizal, he believed that revolutionary struggle would liberate our nation.  Aside from his fight against frailocracy, he also fought against Spanish colonialism and American imperialism later. >In celebration of the Centennial of the 1896 Philippine Revolution, it is very aptly to officially acknowledge the heroism of Bishop Gregorio Aglipay. There is no more proper and fitting way foor the Filipino people and out country to give our tribute to the revolutionary priest who has painstakingly fought for our independence. It is because of him that we are reaping the fruits of an independent Philippines.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1996-11-05

rows.abstract: Rationale: "... our failure to find a lasting solution to the problem of ensuring safe food from our waters does not stem from a lack of capable, responsible and dedicated people in government and in the private sector who are willing to work together. The problem lies in the lack of coordination, unity of direction and dedication to follow through. Seeks, therefore, to establish a COORDINATE BODY which will initially spearhead and catalayze the formulation of a comprehensive program to ensuretht the food we gather from the water is safe to eat.  Creates the NATIONAL AQUATIC FOOD SANITATION COUNCIL for this purpose.
